articles.headline: HSBC: Q3 Earnings Snapshot
articles.summary: LONDON (AP) — LONDON (AP) — HSBC Holdings PLC (HSBC) on Tuesday reported net income of $7.09 billion in its third quarter.

articles.headline: HSBC 3Q pretax profit rises 32% but misses estimates; announces $1 bln buyback
articles.summary: Investing.com -- HSBC Holdings on Tuesday said it plans to launch a further share buyback of up to $1 billion as it reported higher third-quarter profit on Tuesday, supported by stronger net interest income and lower credit impairment charges.

articles.headline: Citigroup Enters China's Securities Market With CSRC Approval
articles.summary: C secures approval to launch a wholly owned securities business in China, expanding its onshore capital markets reach and creating new growth opportunities.

articles.headline: Top Utilities Stocks to Watch: HSBC’s Preferred Picks
articles.summary: Investing.com -- HSBC has identified five preferred utilities stocks positioned to benefit from surging electricity demand driven by data centers and artificial intelligence infrastructure. The investment bank rates all five companies as Buy, citing above-average growth prospects and strong execution capabilities in an evolving power landscape.

articles.headline: Will JPMorgan's Nigeria Expansion Bolster Its Growth Prospects?
articles.summary: JPM advances its Nigeria expansion with approval for a merchant bank, targeting corporate banking, capital markets and cross-border financing opportunities.

articles.headline: HSBC's Kettner Turns Cautions on Equities for Now
articles.summary: "Right now, the bond side of things, the rate side of things, is probably the easier trade to be in," says Max Kettner, chief multi-asset strategist at HSBC Bank. He explains the factors behind his cautious view of equities through the end of the year amid what he calls "narrative bingo." He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance."

articles.headline: HSBC turns cautious short-term on stocks but remains bullish for 2027
articles.summary: Investing.com -- HSBC revealed Monday that it has cut its maximum overweight in equities and its maximum underweight in sovereign bonds.
